resources.title: Burp: reissue requests and investigate unexpected input
resources.learn: Move a request from Proxy history into Repeater; change one parameter, compare responses and recognize useful error disclosure. Follow the linked Proxy/scope prerequisites first.
resources.offline: Save this page and linked Proxy/scope steps before flying. Academy execution requires an account and reachable lab server; saved HTML does not preserve the lab.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched the tutorial and prerequisites notice; also inspected Community feature comparison. No lab launched.

resources.title: How to resend individual requests with Burp Repeater
resources.learn: Short demonstration of the manual request-edit-send-compare loop, history, redirects and tabs. Pair with the current written tutorial because the 2020 interface differs.
resources.offline: Use YouTube offline viewing where supported and verify playback before departure; otherwise save personal notes. A running target is needed to repeat the actions.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Inspected creator metadata, description and transcript; did not watch the video.

resources.title: Everything curl: Command line HTTP
resources.learn: Read the Customize headers and Cookies subsections: reproduce HTTP requests, replace headers and retain session state with a cookie jar. Useful when a browser hides request details.
resources.offline: Save the selected child pages as well as the chapter index. Header examples: https://everything.curl.dev/http/modify/headers.html ; cookie jar: https://everything.curl.dev/http/cookies/writing.html . Sending requests needs a local prepared server or connectivity.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched chapter introduction plus header, cookie concepts and cookie-file pages. Two guessed request-section paths failed and were excluded.

resources.title: ffuf upstream examples: discovery, filters and bounded runs
resources.learn: Place FUZZ in a path, Host header or parameter; filter uninteresting sizes/statuses and bound runs. SecLists supplies candidate input, but learning response comparison matters more than collecting more wordlists.
resources.offline: Save README and a small selected wordlist. Optional home practice: https://github.com/adamtlangley/ffufme offers a local Docker target; build and verify before travel. The hosted ffuf.me requires internet; no local lab was prepared.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched README examples and ffufme README. ffufme is supplementary personal practice, not an assertion that Docker or the lab is approved event software.

resources.title: How to Use Wireshark's Follow TCP Stream Feature
resources.learn: Recover the complete two-way conversation instead of reading one packet at a time; distinguish client and server directions using a Telnet sample.
resources.offline: Arrange permitted offline video playback and save the sample capture in advance. The 2017 UI is old; TCP reconstruction remains the useful lesson.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched original creator description and transcript, including the sample-capture source and stream-direction demonstration; did not watch.

resources.title: TShark manual: saved captures and display filters
resources.learn: Focus on -r to read a PCAP, -Y for Wireshark display filters and -T fields/-e for repeatable field extraction. Distinguish display filters from capture filters.
resources.offline: Save manual and sample PCAP; run locally after checking TShark is installed. No live network needed for saved-capture analysis.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched manual introduction, saved-file and filter behavior; do not treat current documentation as proof of the event binary version.

resources.title: Zeek quick start: turn a PCAP into correlated logs
resources.learn: Use the supplied quickstart.pcap to produce conn.log, http.log and weird.log, then correlate them by uid. Stop before the live-traffic section for airplane practice.
resources.offline: Save the guide and linked quickstart.pcap in advance; verify Zeek in WSL and local analysis before departure. The live-traffic exercise uses external HTTP and is not flight practice.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched the saved-PCAP exercise, expected logs and UID explanation. Sample not downloaded and commands not executed.

resources.title: Wireshark Sample Captures: a small offline packet-analysis exercise
resources.learn: Pick a small HTTP or Telnet capture. Identify endpoints, filter one conversation, reconstruct its stream, then extract matching fields with TShark. These are self-directed exercises, not scored challenges.
resources.offline: Download one selected capture and its description before departure. Static saved files work offline; viewing the index alone is insufficient. No sample was downloaded or tested here.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched the official community capture catalog and its file-format guidance. Selection/exercise is editorial, not a claim that every contributed capture is verified.

resources.title: Nmap reference: interpret ports, services and saved results
resources.learn: Read port states, service/version detection and output sections. Learn what open, closed and filtered do and do not establish before selecting a service-specific tool.
resources.offline: Save the reference for reading. Actual scanning needs a prepared local target or a reachable authorized lab; the online example target is not available without network.
resources.verification: 2026-10-22: Fetched upstream manual table of contents, state definitions and example. Current manual does not verify the approved 7.99 installation; Ncat/Nping need separate reference lookup.
